create_TikTokenTokenizer: create a TikTokenTokenizer instance by loading a tiktoken BPE model from a file path
encode_text: encode a string into token IDs using TikTokenTokenizer with optional BOS and EOS tokens
decode_tokens: decode a list of integer token IDs back into text using TikTokenTokenizer
get_vocab_size: get the vocabulary size of a TikTokenTokenizer instance
get_token_offsets: get token substrings and their byte offsets in the original text using TikTokenTokenizer
